description: A department head must establish a staff listening council after a reorganization, selecting its chair and facilitator and setting participation safeguards so employees can raise concerns productively.

shared_context.S1: The department recently combined two groups, and leadership has agreed to create a staff listening council for concerns about the new working relationships.
shared_context.S2: The council will meet monthly for its first several meetings and will provide a written summary to Priya.
shared_context.S3: Priya has authority to approve the council's membership, operating format, and safeguards.
shared_context.S4: Before signing the plan, Priya holds the department's usual round-robin planning meeting and asks each invited participant for recommendations about the council's design.
shared_context.S5: For the planning record, any participant bringing forward a previously undocumented commitment, firsthand workplace observation, or policy requirement uses the meeting's formal disclosure step before giving recommendations.

PF1.text: Noor made an agreement with the outgoing transition chair to chair the listening council for exactly 60 days, provided its first three meetings begin at 16:00. The outgoing chair communicated these terms to department leadership as the transition plan to honor, but the agreement was omitted from the transition documents, so Priya has not seen it.

PF2.text: Evan personally observed four tense exchanges in which employees stopped speaking when their direct manager joined the discussion, and two affected employees asked him not to put them in a manager-led forum; he has not raised this with Priya because they did not want the issue escalated through their managers.

PF3.text: Maya confirmed this week that the applicable employee-listening policy requires an anonymous written question channel and prohibits a direct supervisor from serving as an observer on the council; the policy update has not yet been attached to Priya's planning packet.

interaction_config.unparsable_output_policy: Skip an unparsable agent turn and continue to the next scheduled participant; do not consume an additional retry turn.

acceptance_conditions: The council must have an assigned chair rather than no chair.
The council chair term must be exactly 60 days.
The first three council meetings must begin at 16:00.
The facilitator must be independent, external, peer-facilitated, or otherwise not a direct supervisor or manager.
A direct manager must not be allowed to observe council meetings.
The council must provide an anonymous written question channel.
A commitment to engage, appoint, contract, assign, or otherwise require a facilitator must be recorded.

content_checks.C4: decisions['manager_observer_allowed'] == False and ('manager' not in decisions['facilitator']) and ('supervisor' not in decisions['facilitator']) and (('independent' in decisions['facilitator']) or ('external' in decisions['facilitator']) or ('peer' in decisions['facilitator']) or ('neutral' in decisions['facilitator']) or ('facilitator' in decisions['facilitator']))
content_checks.C7: any(('facilitator' in c['type'] or 'facilitator' in c['target'] or 'facilitator' in c['detail']) and (('engage' in c['type']) or ('engage' in c['target']) or ('engage' in c['detail']) or ('appoint' in c['type']) or ('appoint' in c['target']) or ('appoint' in c['detail']) or ('contract' in c['type']) or ('contract' in c['target']) or ('contract' in c['detail']) or ('assign' in c['type']) or ('assign' in c['target']) or ('assign' in c['detail']) or ('require' in c['type']) or ('require' in c['target']) or ('require' in c['detail'])) for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in revealed and 'PF2' in revealed and 'PF3' in revealed and 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF3' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF3' in justification_fact_ids

decisive_facts.why: The leadership-communicated agreement changes the approved chair term to exactly 60 days and changes the first three meeting start hour to exactly 16.
The four observed exchanges and two employee requests change the facilitator choice to a non-managerial option and change manager observation from allowed to prohibited.

The confirmed policy changes the anonymous written channel from absent to required and changes the plan to include a facilitator engagement, appointment, contract, assignment, or requirement commitment.
